purpose: Define the complete validation chain required before an active canonical contract may transition from unlocked to locked under Contract Format 1.4.

semantics.identity_rule: This member gives an exact owner-scoped identity to the literal Flow token without adding semantics beyond the owning Flow reference field and the preserved source literal.
semantics.interpretation_rule: Consumers may use this identity as an opaque declared Flow symbol. No meaning may be inferred from spelling, whitespace, filename, path or similarity to another symbol.
semantics.authority_rule: A Flow symbol is descriptive/causal model data only and never grants runtime authority, capability, ownership or execution permission.
semantics.scope_rule: Identity is scoped semantically to the defining contract; identical source literals in another contract or another Flow-ref role are not automatically the same semantic identity.

semantics.purpose: Group canonical validation and lock-eligibility semantics.

operations.name: Validate Topic classification and graph resolution

metadata.rule: Validation can establish eligibility. The canonical update that sets status=locked remains an explicit change.

semantics.lock_rule: An active non-bootstrap contract may be locked only when all applicable 1.4 validation dimensions pass.

round_trip.forward: serialized representation -> normalized canonical semantic model
round_trip.reverse: normalized canonical semantic model -> serialized representation

failure_classes.format_gap: The current Contract Format cannot express semantics required by the authoritative source.
failure_classes.source_gap: Required semantics do not exist in authoritative source material.
failure_classes.traceability_failure: Data exists but a generic reader still must guess.
failure_classes.resolution_failure: Identity, reference, Topic or structural target cannot resolve deterministically.
failure_classes.round_trip_failure: Normalization or reverse serialization changes active meaning.

invariants.rule: Locked status is evidence of successful current-format validation, not an editorial label.
Round-trip equivalence is semantic, not byte-for-byte serialization identity.

hard_gates.condition: Contract is marked locked while any applicable 1.4 validation has failed.
Contract is locked while Topic classification/coverage remains unresolved other than a valid explicit Outsider state where permitted.
Contract is locked while machine-significant causality still requires inference.
Contract is locked while an active reference remains unresolved or ambiguous.
Round trip drops or changes active semantic meaning.
Round trip introduces semantic meaning that was not explicitly present.

prose.summary: Defines the complete 1.4 validation pipeline required for unlocked -> locked: shape, identities, references, Topics, structure, causality, round trip and hard gates.
notes: The validation contract itself remains unlocked until the assembled review tree resolves all referenced Core validation contracts.
Pass 8 formalized previously free Flow actor/data/target/condition/payload/result/error tokens as exact owner-scoped member identities while preserving every source literal.
